x: On May 7th at Crystal Palace, during a Southern Counties A.A.A. open meeting, Toby Staff and Steve Walters had a rare old dust-up in the Youths 1500 metres.
Toby Staff equalled his best in the 800 metres and then took the 400 metres for good measure, whilst the 100 metres was a 'Crosbie Brothers benefit'.

Running in a combined Junior and Youth 1500 metre race at Chiswick on June 27th, Belgrave first year Youths Toby Staff and Peter North both ran well to finish 3rd in 4:32.1 and 5th in 4:59.0 respectively.
This years recipients - Toby Staff and Stephen Walters.

Congratulations particularly go to Toby Staff and Simon Shanks who qualified for the highest grade. If you wish to receive your badge get in touch with Alan Mead, … and they will be applied for on your behalf.
Tony Ambler ran well in 4th position, putting behind him Steve Walter[illegible] and Toby Staff, who both looked a little uncomfortable over the country and missing the track.
Pete Gardner, feeling his way on the track after the cross country season, and Toby Staff (good to see him in action again) also competed and look likely to improve as the season unwinds.
Seniors. 200m: J.Evans 23.3. 400m: A.Mead 52.9. 400mH P.Whitby 57.3; C.Brooks 57.6. Junior. 400m : A.Rosell 55.3. 1500m: T.Staff 4:46.0.
